checksums.name: save_byte_sum_u16
checksums.formula_detail: RAM image: u16_le at logical 0x22E = (sum of unsigned bytes logical 0x000..0x227, 552 bytes) mod 65536; written by FUN_0803c9b8, checked by FUN_0803ca54 (returns -2 on mismatch, -3 on magic mismatch). Raw .sav: each 8-byte block is byte-reversed, so stored bytes appear at raw copy offset 0x228 as 2C 0A (value 0x2C0A big-endian in raw order, 0A 2C after block reversal = u16_le). Sum is permutation-invariant so raw bytes 0x000..0x227 sum to the same value.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 setup: SAD=param1 DAD=param2 CNT=count|0x80000000 (DMA regs 0x040000D4 via literal pool), busy-wait on control high halfword; used for all transfers to/from 0x0D000000

EEPROM read one 8-byte block: bounds check vs config block-count at cfg+4, sends start+address bitstream (addr bits at cfg+8) to 0x0D000000, receives 0x44 halfword bits, reassembles 4x u16 MSB-first in reverse word order (cause of per-8-byte-block reversal in raw .sav)
EEPROM write one 8-byte block: expands address+4x16 data bits to 0x0D000000 (length addr_bits+0x43), calls FUN_08076214, polls EEPROM busy (0x0D000000 & 1), calls FUN_0807629c; returns 0 on success
EEPROM verify: re-reads block via FUN_08076360 and compares 4 halfwords; returns 0 or 0x8000
EEPROM/DMA write assist enable before busy polling; exact registers unknown (literal-pool values absent)
EEPROM/DMA write assist disable after busy polling
Appends DIABLK magic and sum8-u16 checksum to final block of 560-byte serialization buffer
Validates DIABLK magic (else -3) and recomputed byte sum (else -2); returns 0 on success
Writes then read-back-verifies one whole 70-block copy via FUN_08076410/FUN_080764ec; returns -1 write fail, -2 verify fail
Reads one whole 70-block copy via FUN_08076360, validates via FUN_0803ca54, on success CpuSet-copies buffer into RAM save mirror
SAVE entry: alloc 560B buffer, CpuSet RAM mirror into it, FUN_0803c9b8 finalize, FUN_0803cbd0(0) then FUN_0803cbd0(70), free buffer. No static caller recovered
LOAD entry: FUN_0803cce4(0), fallback FUN_0803cce4(70) on failure. No static caller recovered
Descriptor init: writes 0x224, derives desc+4 block count = ((0x224+8)>>3)+1 = 70 blocks (560 bytes); calls FUN_08076174(0x40)
Boot-time save-manager/heap init called from FUN_0800028c
BIOS SWI 0x0B CpuSet wrapper used as memcpy for RAM mirror <-> serialization buffer
